name: Jubilee River Way
summary: Along the flood-relief channel's path on a compacted, fine-gravel surface, and back the same way. Level; firm when dry.
notes: Built from OpenStreetMap and a terrain model on the date shown. Nobody from Driftway has walked it yet, so surfaces are as mapped, not as found.
The Jubilee River is a flood-relief channel. Banks and paths near it can flood; take warning signs at their word on the day.
